name: email
description: The address that was entered on the form

name: confirmUrl
description: One-click link that confirms the subscription. Nothing is sent to this address until it is followed.

name: name
description: Their name, when the form collected one

name: greetingName
description: Their first name if we have one, otherwise a neutral greeting. Use this rather than name so the line never reads 'Hello ,'

name: preferredLocale
description: Language the visitor was browsing in, e.g. en, fr

name: source
description: Where the subscription came from, e.g. WEBSITE

name: subscribedAt
description: When they submitted the form, formatted for reading

name: expiresInDays
description: How long the confirmation link stays valid

name: unsubscribeUrl
description: Link that removes the address outright, for somebody who did not subscribe themselves
